dialogues.speaker: Qingce Village Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Qingce Village Bulletin Board. You can find local news and notes from villagers posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Qiang! Li! We're going to the city tomorrow to make some BIG money! In a few days I'll treat you both to a drink at the wharf!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Note
dialogues.text: "After a year back, we're heading out to sea again with the fleet. Who knows when our next chance to drink together will be?"
